/workspace/SuperGrok1.5 — ROOT BUG gating 5 mamba L3-TC cells (prodigy/muon/looksam/sg11/sg15): the mamba TC kernel is NON-DETERMINISTIC on A/A/A (loss spread ~5e-5, grad maxΔ~1e-3, intermittent NaN) — reproduces EVEN on SAM-off / non-prodigy steps, so it is a latent shared race in the mamba TC forward/backward/scan, NOT the optimizer tails (mamba×{adamw,lion,grokfast,grokadamw,neuralgrok} are A/A/A bit-identical — so the race lives in a phase or scratch carve only the OTHER opts' occupancy/layout exposes).

Reproduce + diagnose with compute-sanitizer (/usr/local/cuda/bin/compute-sanitizer --tool racecheck, then --tool initcheck) on a mamba looksam OR prodigy TC train step. Routing: those cells are gated out of _FUSED_L3_REAL in grokking_optimizers/dispatch.py AND behind C++ env SG_MAMBA_LOOKSAM_PROBE in dispatch.cpp — to run one for the sanitizer you must temporarily add ('mamba3','looksam') to _FUSED_L3_REAL and set SG_MAMBA_LOOKSAM_PROBE=1, and looksam needs its sam_dir extra-state slice allocated in fused_train_step (the harness hit "expected Float found Int" — the state/scalars plumbing for looksam needs the same extra-slice handling adamw has; fix the harness path or use prodigy which has simpler state). CUDA_MPS_PIPE_DIRECTORY=/nonexistent.

Hunt (the kDInner-vs-kD stride-bug class already bit this file once — model_stage_mamba3.cuh mb_layernorm_fwd ldX): (a) uninit scratch read — the per-CTA scan/conv scratch or the Muon/SAM scratch carve OVERLAPPING live scan state (compare carve offsets: which opts touch the region adamw doesn't); (b) missing grid barrier before a cross-CTA read of the reduced grad; (c) float-atomic / work-steal ordering in the mamba dW reduce (make it deterministic fixed-partition, mirror the prodigy P2.6 fix 0cd8f75); (d) NaN from uninit-read. FIX the race at root. VERIFY on FRESH FORCE_CUDA=1 ./build.sh: mamba prodigy AND looksam A/A/A bit-identical 3x, racecheck+initcheck=0, mamba×adamw still bit-identical (no regression). Then register the unblocked cells + gate them. No suppression (fix race, never widen tol). Commit when green. Report: sanitizer root cause + which mamba cells now pass A/A/A.

1	# LookSAM L3-TC wiring plan (decoder → vit → mamba)
2	
3	## Goal / HARD RULE
4	DONE only when fresh `FORCE_CUDA=1 ./build.sh` → `wiring_check.py` shows
5	`path=L3-TC-megakernel(wgmma)` for the cell AND `test_l3tc_tail_gate` A/A/A
6	bit-identical passes. Else stay eager, loud+cited. No false-done.
7	
8	## Eager LookSAM semantics (the parity target)
9	- train loop: fwd+bwd at p → g (reduced grad). Then:
10	  - `should_sam_step()` == (`_global_step % k == 0`); `_global_step` starts 0,
11	    increments inside `step()`. So SAM FIRES at step 1 (0%5==0), and every k.
12	  - `sam_step`: GLOBAL grad norm `‖g‖` over ALL tensors (compute_sam_grad_norm_
13	    device_side); `rho_over_norm = rho/‖g‖`; perturb `p' = p + rho_over_norm·g`
14	    (backup = p.clone()); 2nd fwd+bwd at p' → g_sam; restore p; `sam_dir = g_sam - g`
15	    (PERSISTED state). p.grad restored to g.
16	  - `step()` (EVERY step): `g_adj = (1-alpha)·g + alpha·sam_dir`; AdamW on g_adj.
17	- Intervening steps: reuse cached sam_dir (no 2nd backward).
18	
19	## In-kernel design (decoder TC kernel; same shape vit/mamba)
20	Insert between B2 (reduced grad g ready) and P3, guarded `if constexpr (Opt==LookSAM)`:
21	- sam_dir lives in the persistent `extra` state slice (state[2*total:3*total]) ==
22	  st.sam_dir buffer, total floats, persists across steps. Standard 3*total+1 state.
23	- NEW transient workspace (carved LAST, unconditional, like muon scratch):
24	  - `sam_backup` [total]   — param backup for exact restore
25	  - `sam_grad`   [total]   — g_sam (2nd-backward reduced grad), must NOT clobber g
26	- Host passes `looksam_is_sam_step` (1.0/0.0) + `rho` + `alpha` via FusedScalars.
27	- ON SAM step (st.looksam_sam == 1):
28	  1. global ‖g‖ via the deterministic P2.5-style ascending reduce → rho_over_norm.
29	  2. backup p, perturb p += rho_over_norm·g (per-element, P3-style grid stride).
30	  3. bar.sync; re-run P1' fwd+bwd at perturbed p into acts (reusable) → write g_sam
31	     partials, then re-run P2' grad assembly into `sam_grad` (NOT grad).
32	  4. bar.sync; sam_dir = sam_grad - grad (per element); restore p = sam_backup.
33	  5. bar.sync.
34	- ON non-SAM step: sam_dir already holds the cached direction (state carried). No-op.
35	- P3: apply_optimizer<LookSAM> reads st.sam_dir (already wired in opt_components),
36	  g_adj=(1-alpha)g+alpha·sam_dir, AdamW. UNCHANGED.
37	
38	## Re-invocation feasibility (verified)
39	- dectc_forward_tile / dectc_backward_tile are pure device fns (all state via args:
40	  weights w=dec_bind(params), acts, scratch, smem). Re-running at perturbed params
41	  into the same acts/scratch is structurally fine (acts free after P2 grad assembly).
42	- P2 grad-assembly (dW specs, biases, embed scan, lnvec reduce) writes to a grad ptr.
43	  For the 2nd pass I point it at `sam_grad`.
44	
45	## Host plumbing
46	- dispatch.cpp wgmma_tail_opt_id: add `looksam → 4`.
47	- dispatch.cpp: thread looksam scalars (rho, alpha already via FusedScalars.alpha,
48	  sam_step flag) + bind sam workspace; bump TC workspace size for the 2 extra
49	  total-sized regions.
50	- _opt_scalars_from: add looksam branch (alpha=group['alpha'], looksam_rho, and the
51	  SAM-step flag computed from optimizer._global_step % k).
52	- fused_train_step: forward the looksam extra scalars.
53	- dispatch.py: add (decoder,looksam) etc to _FUSED_L3_REAL + _L3_WGMMA_CELLS;
54	  gemm_impl_for_cell already keys off _L3_WGMMA_CELLS.
55	- train_looksam: call _try_fused_train_step (keep eager sam_step prefix? NO — the L3
56	  kernel does the SAM 2nd backward in-kernel; on a fused hit skip eager sam_step+step).
57	  BUT _global_step cadence must still advance so should_sam_step phase matches; the
58	  host computes the flag from opt._global_step BEFORE the launch and increments after.
59	
60	## tail_gate reference (CRITICAL)
61	The gate injects kernel grad into p.grad and runs opt_ref.step() — but LookSAM.step()
62	blends with sam_dir which is ZERO unless sam_step ran. So the looksam factory/gate
63	branch MUST run the SAM 2nd backward on the reference: opt_ref.sam_step(m_ref, tx, ty,
64	crit) at step 1 (a SAM step) BEFORE injecting g and stepping. Then opt_ref.state[p]
65	['sam_direction'] holds g_sam-g and step() blends faithfully. The (1b) STATE check
66	compares kernel [m|v|extra] — extra == st.sam_dir; reference's sam_direction maps to
67	the extra slot. Need a run_cell_gate looksam branch.
68	
69	## Order
70	1. decoder end-to-end → fresh build → wiring_check + tail_gate green → COMMIT.
71	2. vit (port). 3. mamba (port). Each: fresh build, both gates, commit per cell.
72	If a model can't reach green this session → leave eager, loud+cited reason. NO false-done.

31	//         x_main = SiLU(conv1d(x_main))      (depthwise NON-causal k=3 pad=1)

33	//         y = selective_scan(x_main, dt_proj(dt), B, C)   (softplus INSIDE scan)

40	//   selective_scan(x,dt,B,C)  (:422-441, the PYTHON FALLBACK the race runs):
41	//     A=-exp(A_log); dt=softplus(dt); h=0;
42	//     for t: h = exp(dt_t*A)*h + (dt_t*B_t)*x_t ; y_t = sum_s C_t*h_t.

44	// NUMERICS (verified in the oracle; see mamba_oracle.py):
45	//   * SiLU(x)=x*sigmoid(x); SiLU'(x)=sig(x)*(1+x*(1-sig(x))).
46	//   * softplus(x)=log1p(exp(x)); softplus'(x)=sigmoid(x).
47	//   * Conv1d NON-causal: y[t]=b + W0*x[t-1] + W1*x[t] + W2*x[t+1] (zero-pad).
48	//   * A=-exp(A_log) -> dA_log = dA*A.
49	//   * LayerNorm eps=1e-5; dx uses the two mean-correction terms.
50	//   * CE MEAN over B -> dlogits=(softmax-onehot)/B; head width p=97.

52	// PARALLELIZATION (Option B, batch-parallel, deterministic — IDENTICAL to the
53	// decoder PHASE-1 design):
54	//   * Each CTA owns a FIXED contiguous batch slice (by blockIdx.x — NOT the
55	//     work-steal queue; fp32 sums aren't associative so a varying batch->CTA
56	//     grouping is non-deterministic). The whole CTA cooperates on ONE sample at a
57	//     time and iterates its slice SEQUENTIALLY.

59	//     partial[e] += contrib across the slice's samples in fixed order
60	//     (__syncthreads between samples) — single-writer, no atomics, deterministic.
61	//   * THE SCAN EXPLOIT (seq=8, trivially short): the selective scan is a
62	//     SEQUENTIAL recurrence over seq=8 per (batch, channel j in [0,256)). One
63	//     thread owns channel j, holds the state h[STATE=16] in REGISTERS, and
64	//     UNROLLS t=0..7. The full h[seq][d_inner][state] (~128 KB/sample) does NOT

266	__device__ __forceinline__ float mb_block_sum(float v, float* red) {
267	    const unsigned full = 0xffffffffu;
268	    #pragma unroll
269	    for (int o = 16; o > 0; o >>= 1) v += __shfl_down_sync(full, v, o);
270	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31, warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;

289	    const int lane = threadIdx.x & 31, warp = threadIdx.x >> 5;

297	        if (lane == 0) red[0] = p;

299	    __syncthreads();

305	// ── Primitive linear op (CTA-cooperative). y[s,:out] = x[s,:in] @ W[out,in]^T
306	//    (+ b). One thread per (s,o), strided. ──────────────────────────────────────
307	__device__ __forceinline__ void mb_linear(
308	        const float* __restrict__ x, int in_dim,
309	        const float* __restrict__ W, const float* __restrict__ b, int out_dim,
310	        float* __restrict__ y) {
311	    const int total = mb::kSeq * out_dim;
312	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
313	        const int s = idx / out_dim, o = idx % out_dim;
314	        const float* xr = x + s * in_dim;
315	        const float* Wr = W + (int64_t)o * in_dim;
316	        float acc = (b != nullptr) ? b[o] : 0.0f;
317	        #pragma unroll 4
318	        for (int k = 0; k < in_dim; ++k) acc += xr[k] * Wr[k];
319	        y[s * out_dim + o] = acc;
320	    }
321	    __syncthreads();
322	}
323	
324	// ── LayerNorm forward (last dim width=d). Caches xhat + inv_std. ──────────────
325	// ldX is the EXPLICIT row stride of x (no default) — the caller stages the
326	// residual into adj_c, whose DECLARED width is kDInner (256), not kD (128).
327	// The packed-stride read (x + s*kD) was the stride-bug class of 5cb32b8 all
328	// over again: row 0 correct, rows 1..7 read uninitialized smem — caught on
329	// first silicon run of the cell (the CPU mirror indexes semantically and
330	// cannot see it). y/xhat_out remain packed kD-wide buffers.
331	__device__ __forceinline__ void mb_layernorm_fwd(
332	        const float* __restrict__ x, const float* __restrict__ gamma,
333	        const float* __restrict__ beta, float* __restrict__ y,
334	        float* __restrict__ xhat_out, float* __restrict__ inv_out, float* red,
335	        int ldX) {
336	    for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) {
337	        const float* xr = x + s * ldX;
338	        float sum = 0.0f;
339	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) sum += xr[j];
340	        float mean = mb_block_sum(sum, red) / (float)mb::kD;
341	        float vs = 0.0f;
342	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) { float c = xr[j] - mean; vs += c * c; }
343	        float var = mb_block_sum(vs, red) / (float)mb::kD;
344	        float inv = rsqrtf(var + mb::kLnEps);
345	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) inv_out[s] = inv;
346	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
347	            float xh = (xr[j] - mean) * inv;
348	            xhat_out[s * mb::kD + j] = xh;
349	            y[s * mb::kD + j] = xh * gamma[j] + beta[j];
350	        }
351	        __syncthreads();
352	    }
353	}
354	
355	// ── LayerNorm backward (mirrors decoder dec_layernorm_bwd; accumulates affine). ─
356	__device__ inline void mb_layernorm_bwd(
357	        const float* __restrict__ dy, const float* __restrict__ xhat,
358	        const float* __restrict__ inv, const float* __restrict__ gamma,
359	        float* __restrict__ dx_out, float* __restrict__ gw, float* __restrict__ gb,
360	        float* red) {
361	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
362	        float dgw = 0.0f, dgb = 0.0f;
363	        #pragma unroll
364	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) {
365	            float d = dy[s * mb::kD + j];
366	            dgb += d; dgw += d * xhat[s * mb::kD + j];
367	        }
368	        gw[j] += dgw; gb[j] += dgb;
369	    }
370	    for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) {
371	        const float* dyr = dy + s * mb::kD;
372	        const float* xhr = xhat + s * mb::kD;
373	        float sda = 0.0f, sdax = 0.0f;
374	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
375	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j];
376	            sda += dxhat; sdax += dxhat * xhr[j];
377	        }
378	        sda = mb_block_sum(sda, red);
379	        sdax = mb_block_sum(sdax, red);
380	        float inv_s = inv[s];
381	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
382	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * gamma[j];
383	            dx_out[s * mb::kD + j] =
384	                inv_s * (dxhat - (sda + xhr[j] * sdax) / (float)mb::kD);
385	        }
386	        __syncthreads();
387	    }
388	}

390	// ── dW += dY^T @ X for a linear Y = X @ W^T (+ b). dX = dY @ W (set or add).
391	//    Owner-thread per (o,i) for dW; db[o]+=Σ_s dY. Mirrors decoder dec_linear_bwd.─
392	__device__ inline void mb_linear_bwd(
393	        const float* __restrict__ dY, const float* __restrict__ X,
394	        const float* __restrict__ W, int in_dim, int out_dim,
395	        float* __restrict__ dW, float* __restrict__ db,
396	        float* __restrict__ dx_out, bool set_dx) {
397	    const int wtot = out_dim * in_dim;
398	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < wtot; idx += blockDim.x) {
399	        const int o = idx / in_dim, i = idx % in_dim;
400	        float acc = 0.0f;
401	        #pragma unroll
402	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) acc += dY[s * out_dim + o] * X[s * in_dim + i];
403	        dW[(int64_t)o * in_dim + i] += acc;
404	    }
405	    if (db != nullptr) {
406	        for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < out_dim; o += blockDim.x) {
407	            float acc = 0.0f;
408	            #pragma unroll
409	            for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) acc += dY[s * out_dim + o];
410	            db[o] += acc;
411	        }
412	    }
413	    const int xtot = mb::kSeq * in_dim;
414	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < xtot; idx += blockDim.x) {
415	        const int s = idx / in_dim, i = idx % in_dim;
416	        float acc = 0.0f;
417	        for (int o = 0; o < out_dim; ++o) acc += dY[s * out_dim + o] * W[(int64_t)o * in_dim + i];
418	        if (set_dx) dx_out[s * in_dim + i] = acc;
419	        else dx_out[s * in_dim + i] += acc;
420	    }
421	    __syncthreads();
422	}
423	
424	// ── CONV1D (depthwise, NON-causal, k=3, pad=1) forward. ───────────────────────
425	//   out[t,c] = b[c] + W[c,0,0]*in[t-1,c] + W[c,0,1]*in[t,c] + W[c,0,2]*in[t+1,c].
426	//   Mirrors mamba_oracle.conv1d_forward.
427	__device__ inline void mb_conv1d_fwd(const float* __restrict__ in,
428	                              const float* __restrict__ W,
429	                              const float* __restrict__ b,
430	                              float* __restrict__ out) {
431	    const int total = mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner;
432	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
433	        const int t = idx / mb::kDInner, c = idx % mb::kDInner;
434	        const float* Wc = W + (int64_t)c * mb::kConvK;
435	        float acc = b[c];
436	        #pragma unroll
437	        for (int k = 0; k < mb::kConvK; ++k) {
438	            const int tt = t + k - 1;   // k=0->t-1, k=1->t, k=2->t+1
439	            if (tt >= 0 && tt < mb::kSeq) acc += Wc[k] * in[tt * mb::kDInner + c];
440	        }
441	        out[t * mb::kDInner + c] = acc;
442	    }
443	    __syncthreads();
444	}
445	
446	// ── CONV1D backward. dW[c,0,k]+=Σ_t dy[t,c]*in[t+k-1,c]; db[c]+=Σ_t dy[t,c];
447	//   dx[tt,c]=Σ_k W[c,0,k]*dy[tt-k+1,c] (in-range). Mirrors conv1d_backward.
448	__device__ inline void mb_conv1d_bwd(const float* __restrict__ dy,
449	                             const float* __restrict__ in,
450	                             const float* __restrict__ W,
451	                             float* __restrict__ dW, float* __restrict__ db,
452	                             float* __restrict__ dx_out) {
453	    for (int c = threadIdx.x; c < mb::kDInner; c += blockDim.x) {
454	        float dwk[mb::kConvK]; float dbc = 0.0f;
455	        #pragma unroll
456	        for (int k = 0; k < mb::kConvK; ++k) dwk[k] = 0.0f;
457	        #pragma unroll
458	        for (int t = 0; t < mb::kSeq; ++t) {
459	            float dyv = dy[t * mb::kDInner + c];
460	            dbc += dyv;
461	            #pragma unroll
462	            for (int k = 0; k < mb::kConvK; ++k) {
463	                const int tt = t + k - 1;
464	                if (tt >= 0 && tt < mb::kSeq) dwk[k] += dyv * in[tt * mb::kDInner + c];
465	            }
466	        }
467	        #pragma unroll
468	        for (int k = 0; k < mb::kConvK; ++k) dW[(int64_t)c * mb::kConvK + k] += dwk[k];
469	        db[c] += dbc;
470	    }
471	    const int total = mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner;
472	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x) {
473	        const int tt = idx / mb::kDInner, c = idx % mb::kDInner;
474	        const float* Wc = W + (int64_t)c * mb::kConvK;
475	        float acc = 0.0f;
476	        #pragma unroll
477	        for (int k = 0; k < mb::kConvK; ++k) {
478	            const int t = tt - k + 1;   // tt = t+k-1 -> t = tt-k+1
479	            if (t >= 0 && t < mb::kSeq) acc += Wc[k] * dy[t * mb::kDInner + c];
480	        }
481	        dx_out[tt * mb::kDInner + c] = acc;
482	    }
483	    __syncthreads();
484	}
485	
486	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
487	//  SELECTIVE SCAN forward — THE CORE EXPLOIT. One thread owns channel j; holds
488	//  the state h[kState] in REGISTERS and unrolls t=0..kSeq-1. Reads x_main (=silu
489	//  (conv)) [t][j], dt_pre [t][j] (PRE-softplus), Bmat[t][s], Cmat[t][s],
490	//  A_log[j][s]. Writes y_scan[t][j]. Mirrors selective_scan_forward.
491	//    A[s]=-exp(A_log[j,s]); dt_t=softplus(dt_pre[t,j]);
492	//    h[s] = exp(dt_t*A[s])*h[s] + dt_t*Bmat[t,s]*x[t,j]; y[t,j]=Σ_s Cmat[t,s]*h[s].
493	//  x_main is passed in (caller materialises silu(conv) into a buffer). ──────────
494	__device__ inline void mb_scan_fwd(const float* __restrict__ A_log,
495	                           const float* __restrict__ x_main,  // [kSeq,d_inner]
496	                           const MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a,
497	                           float* __restrict__ y_scan_out) {
498	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kDInner; j += blockDim.x) {
499	        float A[mb::kState];
500	        #pragma unroll
501	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s)
502	            A[s] = -__expf(A_log[(int64_t)j * mb::kState + s]);
503	        float h[mb::kState];
504	        #pragma unroll
505	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s) h[s] = 0.0f;
506	        #pragma unroll
507	        for (int t = 0; t < mb::kSeq; ++t) {
508	            const float xv = x_main[t * mb::kDInner + j];
509	            const float dt_t = mb_softplus(a->dt_pre[t][j]);
510	            float yacc = 0.0f;
511	            #pragma unroll
512	            for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s) {
513	                const float adec = __expf(dt_t * A[s]);
514	                h[s] = adec * h[s] + dt_t * a->Bmat[t][s] * xv;
515	                yacc += a->Cmat[t][s] * h[s];
516	            }
517	            y_scan_out[t * mb::kDInner + j] = yacc;
518	        }
519	    }
520	    __syncthreads();
521	}
522	
523	// SELECTIVE SCAN backward. Per channel j (one thread): RECOMPUTE the forward
524	// keeping h_hist[kSeq+1][kState] in registers (seq=8 — NO checkpoint), then
525	// reverse-scan (derivation transcribed from mamba_oracle.selective_scan_backward):
526	//   gh[s] += Cmat[t,s]*dy[t,j]   (full dL/dh_t after adding y_t's direct term)
527	//   dC_js[t,s] = h_t[s]*dy[t,j];  dB_js[t,s] = dt_t*x*gh[s]
528	//   dx_main_scan[t,j] = Σ_s Bmat[t,s]*dt_t*gh[s]
529	//   ddt_post = Σ_s (A[s]*a_t*h_{t-1}+Bmat[t,s]*x)*gh[s]
530	//   dA[s] += dt_t*a_t*h_{t-1}*gh[s];  gh[s] <- a_t*gh[s]
531	//   ddt_pre[t,j] = ddt_post * softplus'(dt_pre[t,j])
532	//   dA_log[j,s]  += dA[s]*A[s]   (A=-exp(A_log))   (owner j -> plain write)
533	// dBmat/dCmat are shared across channels -> reduced over threads in a FIXED order
534	// (mb_block_sum, ascending lane/warp = deterministic) into smem dBmat/dCmat.
535	__device__ inline void mb_scan_bwd(const float* __restrict__ A_log,
536	                           const float* __restrict__ x_main,    // [kSeq,d_inner]
537	                           const MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a,
538	                           const float* __restrict__ dy_scan,   // [kSeq,d_inner]
539	                           float* __restrict__ dx_main_scan,    // [kSeq,d_inner] SET
540	                           float* __restrict__ ddt_pre,         // [kSeq,d_inner] SET
541	                           float* __restrict__ dBmat,           // [kSeq,kState] += (smem; zeroed by caller)
542	                           float* __restrict__ dCmat,           // [kSeq,kState] += (smem; zeroed by caller)
543	                           float* __restrict__ g_A_log,         // [d_inner,state] partial (+=)
544	                           float* __restrict__ red) {
545	    float dB_loc[mb::kSeq][mb::kState];
546	    float dC_loc[mb::kSeq][mb::kState];
547	    const bool active = (threadIdx.x < mb::kDInner);
548	    if (active) {
549	        const int j = threadIdx.x;
550	        float A[mb::kState], hh[mb::kSeq + 1][mb::kState];
551	        float dt_save[mb::kSeq], a_save[mb::kSeq][mb::kState];
552	        #pragma unroll
553	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s) {
554	            A[s] = -__expf(A_log[(int64_t)j * mb::kState + s]);
555	            hh[0][s] = 0.0f;
556	        }
557	        // forward recompute -> hh[t+1] = h_t (hh[0] = h_{-1} = 0).
558	        #pragma unroll
559	        for (int t = 0; t < mb::kSeq; ++t) {
560	            const float xv = x_main[t * mb::kDInner + j];
561	            const float dt_t = mb_softplus(a->dt_pre[t][j]);
562	            dt_save[t] = dt_t;
563	            #pragma unroll
564	            for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s) {
565	                const float adec = __expf(dt_t * A[s]);
566	                a_save[t][s] = adec;
567	                hh[t + 1][s] = adec * hh[t][s] + dt_t * a->Bmat[t][s] * xv;
568	            }
569	        }
570	        // reverse scan.
571	        float gh[mb::kState], dA[mb::kState];
572	        #pragma unroll
573	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s) { gh[s] = 0.0f; dA[s] = 0.0f; }
574	        #pragma unroll
575	        for (int t = mb::kSeq - 1; t >= 0; --t) {
576	            const float xv = x_main[t * mb::kDInner + j];
577	            const float dt_t = dt_save[t];
578	            const float dyv = dy_scan[t * mb::kDInner + j];
579	            float dx_acc = 0.0f, ddt_acc = 0.0f;
580	            #pragma unroll
581	            for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s) {
582	                const float h_t = hh[t + 1][s];
583	                const float h_tm1 = hh[t][s];
584	                const float adec = a_save[t][s];
585	                const float cc = a->Cmat[t][s];
586	                const float bb = a->Bmat[t][s];
587	                dC_loc[t][s] = h_t * dyv;
588	                gh[s] += cc * dyv;
589	                dB_loc[t][s] = dt_t * xv * gh[s];
590	                dx_acc += bb * dt_t * gh[s];
591	                ddt_acc += (A[s] * adec * h_tm1 + bb * xv) * gh[s];
592	                dA[s] += dt_t * adec * h_tm1 * gh[s];
593	                gh[s] = adec * gh[s];
594	            }
595	            dx_main_scan[t * mb::kDInner + j] = dx_acc;
596	            ddt_pre[t * mb::kDInner + j] = ddt_acc * mb_softplus_grad(a->dt_pre[t][j]);
597	        }
598	        #pragma unroll
599	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s)
600	            g_A_log[(int64_t)j * mb::kState + s] += dA[s] * A[s];
601	    } else {
602	        #pragma unroll
603	        for (int t = 0; t < mb::kSeq; ++t)
604	            #pragma unroll
605	            for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s) { dB_loc[t][s] = 0.0f; dC_loc[t][s] = 0.0f; }
606	    }
607	    // Reduce dB_loc/dC_loc across channels (threads) in fixed order -> dBmat/dCmat.
608	    #pragma unroll
609	    for (int t = 0; t < mb::kSeq; ++t) {
610	        #pragma unroll
611	        for (int s = 0; s < mb::kState; ++s) {
612	            float sb = mb_block_sum(dB_loc[t][s], red);
613	            float sc = mb_block_sum(dC_loc[t][s], red);
614	            if (threadIdx.x == 0) { dBmat[t * mb::kState + s] += sb; dCmat[t * mb::kState + s] += sc; }
615	        }
616	    }
617	    __syncthreads();
618	}

620	// ── Materialise x_main = silu(conv) for layer li into `out` [kSeq,d_inner]. ────
621	__device__ __forceinline__ void mb_make_x_main(const MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a,
622	                                               float* __restrict__ out) {
623	    const int total = mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner;
624	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < total; idx += blockDim.x)
625	        out[idx] = mb_silu(a->conv[idx / mb::kDInner][idx % mb::kDInner]);
626	    __syncthreads();
627	}
628	
629	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
630	//  FORWARD for one sample (CTA-cooperative). Mirrors mamba_oracle.mamba_forward.
631	//  Caches BOTH layers' forward activations into sm->act[li]; returns sample NLL.
632	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
633	__device__ inline float mb_forward_sample(const MambaWeights& w, const int* tokens_s,
634	                                    int target, MambaSampleSmem* sm) {
635	    // Embedding + positional.
636	    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < mb::kSeq * mb::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
637	        const int s = idx / mb::kD, j = idx % mb::kD;
638	        sm->layer_in[0][s][j] = w.tok[(int64_t)tokens_s[s] * mb::kD + j]
639	                              + w.pos[(int64_t)s * mb::kD + j];
640	    }
641	    __syncthreads();
642	
643	    for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li) {
644	        const MambaWeights::Layer& L = w.layer[li];
645	        MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a = &sm->act[li];
646	        float* hin = &sm->layer_in[li][0][0];   // residual x
647	        // xz = in_proj(x); split in_w rows [0,d_inner)->x_main_raw, [d_inner,2di)->z.
648	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner; idx += blockDim.x) {
649	            const int s = idx / mb::kDInner, o = idx % mb::kDInner;
650	            const float* xr = hin + s * mb::kD;
651	            const float* Wr0 = L.in_w + (int64_t)o * mb::kD;
652	            const float* Wr1 = L.in_w + (int64_t)(mb::kDInner + o) * mb::kD;
653	            float a0 = 0.0f, a1 = 0.0f;
654	            #pragma unroll 4
655	            for (int k = 0; k < mb::kD; ++k) { float xv = xr[k]; a0 += xv * Wr0[k]; a1 += xv * Wr1[k]; }
656	            a->x_main_raw[s][o] = a0;
657	            a->z[s][o] = a1;
658	        }
659	        __syncthreads();
660	        // conv1d (NON-causal) -> a->conv (PRE-silu, cached for bwd).
661	        mb_conv1d_fwd(&a->x_main_raw[0][0], L.conv_w, L.conv_b, &a->conv[0][0]);
662	        // x_main = silu(conv) materialised into adj_a scratch (transient this layer).
663	        mb_make_x_main(a, &sm->adj_a[0][0]);
664	        // x_proj(x_main) -> dt_raw (stage in dbc scratch), Bmat, Cmat.
665	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < mb::kSeq * mb::kDbc; idx += blockDim.x) {
666	            const int s = idx / mb::kDbc, o = idx % mb::kDbc;
667	            const float* xr = &sm->adj_a[s][0];   // x_main
668	            const float* Wr = L.x_proj_w + (int64_t)o * mb::kDInner;
669	            float acc = 0.0f;
670	            #pragma unroll 4
671	            for (int k = 0; k < mb::kDInner; ++k) acc += xr[k] * Wr[k];
672	            if (o < mb::kDtRank) sm->dbc[s][o] = acc;   // dt_raw staged in dbc[:, :dt_rank]
673	            else if (o < mb::kDtRank + mb::kState) a->Bmat[s][o - mb::kDtRank] = acc;
674	            else a->Cmat[s][o - mb::kDtRank - mb::kState] = acc;
675	        }
676	        __syncthreads();
677	        // dt_pre = dt_proj(dt_raw) + bias  -> a->dt_pre (cached).
678	        // mb_linear over the dt_raw staged in dbc[:, :dt_rank] (row stride kDbc!).
679	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner; idx += blockDim.x) {
680	            const int s = idx / mb::kDInner, o = idx % mb::kDInner;
681	            const float* xr = &sm->dbc[s][0];   // dt_raw occupies [0,dt_rank)
682	            const float* Wr = L.dt_proj_w + (int64_t)o * mb::kDtRank;
683	            float acc = L.dt_proj_b[o];
684	            #pragma unroll
685	            for (int k = 0; k < mb::kDtRank; ++k) acc += xr[k] * Wr[k];
686	            a->dt_pre[s][o] = acc;
687	        }
688	        __syncthreads();
689	        // selective scan -> a->y_scan (cached).
690	        mb_scan_fwd(L.A_log, &sm->adj_a[0][0], a, &a->y_scan[0][0]);
691	        // gate+skip+out_proj: y_gated=(y_scan + x_main*D)*silu(z); stage in adj_b.
692	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner; idx += blockDim.x) {
693	            const int s = idx / mb::kDInner, c = idx % mb::kDInner;
694	            float yv = a->y_scan[s][c] + sm->adj_a[s][c] * L.D[c];   // x_main = adj_a
695	            sm->adj_b[s][c] = yv * mb_silu(a->z[s][c]);              // adj_b := y_gated
696	        }
697	        __syncthreads();
698	        // r = out_proj(y_gated) + residual; staged into adj_c[:, :d] then LN -> dst.
699	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < mb::kSeq * mb::kD; idx += blockDim.x) {
700	            const int s = idx / mb::kD, o = idx % mb::kD;
701	            const float* Wr = L.out_w + (int64_t)o * mb::kDInner;
702	            const float* yg = &sm->adj_b[s][0];
703	            float acc = 0.0f;
704	            #pragma unroll 4
705	            for (int c = 0; c < mb::kDInner; ++c) acc += yg[c] * Wr[c];
706	            sm->adj_c[s][o] = acc + hin[s * mb::kD + o];   // adj_c := r (uses [.,:d])
707	        }
708	        __syncthreads();
709	        float* dst = (li + 1 < mb::kLayers) ? &sm->layer_in[li + 1][0][0]
710	                                            : &sm->final_in[0][0];
711	        mb_layernorm_fwd(&sm->adj_c[0][0], L.n_w, L.n_b, dst,
712	                         &a->ln_xhat[0][0], &a->ln_inv[0], sm->red,
713	                         /*ldX=*/mb::kDInner);  // adj_c rows are kDInner wide
714	    }
715	
716	    // Final norm (LAST position) + head -> logits -> NLL.
717	    const float* hlast = &sm->final_in[mb::kSeq - 1][0];
718	    float sum = 0.0f;
719	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) sum += hlast[j];
720	    float mean = mb_block_sum(sum, sm->red) / (float)mb::kD;
721	    float vs = 0.0f;
722	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) { float c = hlast[j] - mean; vs += c * c; }
723	    float var = mb_block_sum(vs, sm->red) / (float)mb::kD;
724	    float inv = rsqrtf(var + mb::kLnEps);
725	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) sm->fn_inv[0] = inv;
726	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
727	        float xh = (hlast[j] - mean) * inv;
728	        sm->fn_xhat[mb::kSeq - 1][j] = xh;
729	        sm->adj_a[0][j] = xh * w.norm_w[j] + w.norm_b[j];   // hn staged in adj_a[0]
730	    }
731	    __syncthreads();
732	    for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < mb::kPHead; o += blockDim.x) {
733	        const float* Wr = w.out_w + (int64_t)o * mb::kD;
734	        float acc = w.out_b[o];
735	        #pragma unroll 4
736	        for (int k = 0; k < mb::kD; ++k) acc += sm->adj_a[0][k] * Wr[k];
737	        sm->logits[o] = acc;
738	    }
739	    __syncthreads();
740	    float lmax = -CUDART_INF_F;
741	    for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < mb::kPHead; o += blockDim.x) lmax = fmaxf(lmax, sm->logits[o]);
742	    lmax = mb_block_max(lmax, sm->red);
743	    float es = 0.0f;
744	    for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < mb::kPHead; o += blockDim.x) es += __expf(sm->logits[o] - lmax);
745	    es = mb_block_sum(es, sm->red);
746	    float logz = lmax + __logf(es);
747	    return logz - sm->logits[target];
748	}
749	
750	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
751	//  BACKWARD for one sample (CTA-cooperative). Assumes mb_forward_sample ran for
752	//  THIS sample (act[*] caches + final/fn caches + logits populated). Accumulates
753	//  every weight grad into the CTA partial `g`. Mirrors mamba_oracle.mamba_backward
754	//  + ssm_layer_backward, in the documented order 1..13.
755	// ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
756	__device__ inline void mb_backward_sample(const MambaWeights& w, const MambaGrad& g,
757	                                    const int* tokens_s, int target, int B,
758	                                    MambaSampleSmem* sm) {
759	    // ── CE backward: dlogits = (softmax - onehot)/B. ──
760	    float lmax = -CUDART_INF_F;
761	    for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < mb::kPHead; o += blockDim.x) lmax = fmaxf(lmax, sm->logits[o]);
762	    lmax = mb_block_max(lmax, sm->red);
763	    float es = 0.0f;
764	    for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < mb::kPHead; o += blockDim.x) es += __expf(sm->logits[o] - lmax);
765	    es = mb_block_sum(es, sm->red);
766	    float inv_es = 1.0f / es;
767	    for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < mb::kPHead; o += blockDim.x) {
768	        float smo = __expf(sm->logits[o] - lmax) * inv_es;
769	        sm->logits[o] = (smo - ((o == target) ? 1.0f : 0.0f)) / (float)B;
770	    }
771	    __syncthreads();
772	    // ── head: logits = hn @ out_w^T + out_b; hn = fn_xhat[last]*norm_w + norm_b. ──
773	    for (int o = threadIdx.x; o < mb::kPHead; o += blockDim.x) {
774	        float dl = sm->logits[o];
775	        g.out_b[o] += dl;
776	        float* gwrow = g.out_w + (int64_t)o * mb::kD;
777	        const float* xh = &sm->fn_xhat[mb::kSeq - 1][0];
778	        #pragma unroll 4
779	        for (int j = 0; j < mb::kD; ++j) gwrow[j] += dl * (xh[j] * w.norm_w[j] + w.norm_b[j]);
780	    }
781	    __syncthreads();
782	    // dhn[j] -> dr row 0 (scratch).
783	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
784	        float acc = 0.0f;
785	        for (int o = 0; o < mb::kPHead; ++o) acc += sm->logits[o] * w.out_w[(int64_t)o * mb::kD + j];
786	        sm->dr[0][j] = acc;
787	    }
788	    __syncthreads();
789	    // ── final-norm bwd (single row last): accumulate norm g/b, dx -> dh. ──
790	    for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
791	        float d = sm->dr[0][j], xh = sm->fn_xhat[mb::kSeq - 1][j];
792	        g.norm_b[j] += d; g.norm_w[j] += d * xh;
793	    }
794	    __syncthreads();
795	    {
796	        const float* dyr = &sm->dr[0][0];
797	        const float* xhr = &sm->fn_xhat[mb::kSeq - 1][0];
798	        float sda = 0.0f, sdax = 0.0f;
799	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
800	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * w.norm_w[j];
801	            sda += dxhat; sdax += dxhat * xhr[j];
802	        }
803	        sda = mb_block_sum(sda, sm->red);
804	        sdax = mb_block_sum(sdax, sm->red);
805	        float inv_s = sm->fn_inv[0];
806	        for (int j = threadIdx.x; j < mb::kD; j += blockDim.x) {
807	            float dxhat = dyr[j] * w.norm_w[j];
808	            float dlast = inv_s * (dxhat - (sda + xhr[j] * sdax) / (float)mb::kD);
809	            for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) sm->dh[s][j] = 0.0f;
810	            sm->dh[mb::kSeq - 1][j] = dlast;
811	        }
812	        __syncthreads();
813	    }
814	    // dh = grad wrt last layer's OUTPUT [kSeq,d] (only last pos nonzero).
815	
816	    for (int li = mb::kLayers - 1; li >= 0; --li) {
817	        const MambaWeights::Layer& L = w.layer[li];
818	        const MambaGrad::Layer& G = g.layer[li];
819	        MambaSampleSmem::LayerAct* a = &sm->act[li];
820	        float* hin = &sm->layer_in[li][0][0];   // residual x for this layer
821	        // (1) out = LN(r) -> dr; accumulate per-layer norm g/b. dr lives in sm->dr.
822	        mb_layernorm_bwd(&sm->dh[0][0], &a->ln_xhat[0][0], &a->ln_inv[0],
823	                         L.n_w, &sm->dr[0][0], G.n_w, G.n_b, sm->red);
824	        // (2) r = y_out + residual(=hin): dy_out = dr ; dx_residual = dr (kept in dr).
825	        // (3) out_proj bwd: need y_gated = (y_scan + x_main*D)*silu(z). Recompute
826	        //     y_gated into adj_b (x_main = silu(conv) into adj_a first).
827	        mb_make_x_main(a, &sm->adj_a[0][0]);   // adj_a := x_main
828	        for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < mb::kSeq * mb::kDInner; idx += blockDim.x) {
829	            const int s = idx / mb::kDInner, c = idx % mb::kDInner;
830	            float yv = a->y_scan[s][c] + sm->adj_a[s][c] * L.D[c];
831	            sm->adj_b[s][c] = yv * mb_silu(a->z[s][c]);   // adj_b := y_gated
832	        }
833	        __syncthreads();
834	        //   dW_out += dy_out^T @ y_gated ; dy_gated = dy_out @ out_w -> adj_a
835	        //   (x_main no longer needed from adj_a until the dx_main paths below;
836	        //   we re-materialise x_main when needed — but D-skip path needs x_main
837	        //   NOW. So compute the gate bwd that consumes x_main BEFORE clobbering
838	        //   adj_a. Reorder: do out_proj dW first (reads adj_b only), then gate
839	        //   bwd (reads adj_a=x_main, adj_b=y_gated, z), producing dy_scan + dz +
840	        //   D-path + dD, THEN overwrite adj_a with dy_gated? No — gate bwd needs
841	        //   dy_gated. So compute dy_gated into adj_c (free), keep adj_a=x_main.)
842	        {
843	            const float* dY = &sm->dr[0][0];        // dy_out [kSeq,d]
844	            const float* yg = &sm->adj_b[0][0];     // y_gated [kSeq,d_inner]
845	            const int wtot = mb::kD * mb::kDInner;
846	            for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < wtot; idx += blockDim.x) {
847	                const int o = idx / mb::kDInner, c = idx % mb::kDInner;
848	                float acc = 0.0f;
849	                #pragma unroll
850	                for (int s = 0; s < mb::kSeq; ++s) acc += dY[s * mb::kD + o] * yg[s * mb::kDInner + c];
851	                G.out_w[(int64_t)o * mb::kDInner + c] += acc;

5	// megakernel. ONE persistent kernel per training step runs the REAL Mamba
6	// (selective-SSM) forward+backward AND the optimizer math, separated only by
7	// in-kernel grid barriers — real model math, real optimizer math, ZERO
8	// intermediate kernel launches. The Mamba counterpart of PHASE 1's

11	// This composes:
12	//   * the REAL Mamba fwd/bwd stages (model_stage_mamba3.cuh — transcribed
13	//     line-for-line from the verified PyTorch oracle, asserted bit-identical to
14	//     autograd INCLUDING the selective-scan reverse-time backward, and
15	//     structurally mirrored on CPU),
16	//   * the existing persistent substrate (megakernel_common.cuh: task queue, the
17	//     hand-built sense-reversing GridBarrier),
18	//   * the existing REAL optimizer tail (opt_components.cuh::apply_optimizer<Opt>).

20	// STAGE / BARRIER LAYOUT (identical to the decoder — 5 phases, B0..B2 + the
21	// fused sync_reset; see the per-stage comments):
22	//   P0  each CTA zeroes its OWN grad-partial slice + loss slot.
23	//   --- grid barrier B0 ---
24	//   P1  BATCH-PARALLEL fwd+bwd: each CTA owns a FIXED contiguous batch slice (by
25	//       blockIdx.x), processes its samples ONE AT A TIME (CTA-cooperative),
26	//       broadcasting the sample's kSeq int tokens + target into smem, running
27	//       mb_forward_sample + mb_backward_sample, accumulating each sample's
28	//       weight-grad into the CTA's partial with a single-owner-thread-per-element
29	//       rule (no atomics → deterministic), and summing its slice's NLL (fp32).
30	//   --- grid barrier B1 ---
31	//   P2  DETERMINISTIC cross-CTA reduce: sum partial[0..nCTA) in ASCENDING CTA
32	//       index into the global grad (no float atomics; order fixed → reuses the
33	//       work-steal queue to pick WHO reduces which tensor). Loss: fp64 ordered
34	//       sum → loss/B → a device float the host reads back (by CTA 0).
35	//   --- grid barrier B2 (sync_reset: also resets the queue for P3) ---
36	//   P3  the REAL apply_optimizer<Opt> tail consumes the reduced grad in place.

40	// layers' forward activations cached, d_inner=256), which CANNOT be a static
41	// __shared__ (48 KB cap). So this kernel declares `extern __shared__` and the
42	// LAUNCHER must, all three of: (1) cudaFuncSetAttribute(kernel,

44	// dynamicSMemBytes=kMambaSmemBytes to cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMSM (so the
45	// occ≥1 hang-freedom check is honest); (3) pass it at <<<...>>>. Missing ANY of
46	// these makes the kernel silently fail to launch — see the launcher. The scan
47	// state stays in per-thread REGISTERS (the seq=8 exploit), so smem does NOT
48	// explode to the ~128 KB an h-in-smem scan would need — see model_stage_mamba3.cuh.

116	__device__ __forceinline__ FusedOptState
117	mamba_rebase_state(const FusedOptState& s, int64_t off) {

119	    if (t.exp_avg)    t.exp_avg    += off;

134	// workspace. Kept a SEPARATE kernel + launcher (not folded into the surrogate
135	// fused_megakernel) so the surrogate path is untouched. MambaTokenCtx mirrors the
136	// decoder's DecoderTokenCtx (int tokens, NOT ViT's float patches).
137	//
138	// Workspace layout (one flat float buffer the host allocates + the kernel owns):
139	//   [0 .. nCTA*total)              : per-CTA grad partials (cta-major)
140	//   [nCTA*total .. nCTA*total+nCTA): per-CTA loss partials (NLL sum per slice)

143	struct MambaTokenCtx {
144	    const int* tokens;   // [B, kSeq] int32 token ids in [0, kVocab)
145	    const int* targets;  // [B]       int32 target ids in [0, kPHead)
146	    int        B;        // batch size
147	    float*     workspace; // grad partials + loss partials + reduced loss
148	    float*     loss_out;  // device float the kernel writes the mean loss into

151	// ── The persistent megakernel (L3-REAL). gridDim.x = #SMs (one CTA/SM), 256
152	//    threads/CTA. MambaSampleSmem (~141.72 KB) lives in DYNAMIC smem (extern). ──
153	// sizes/offsets are NOT host-passed: per-tensor numel/offset live in the
154	// __constant__ tables kMambaSizes/kMambaOffsets (mamba3_layout.cuh), read directly
155	// by the reduce + optimizer phases.
156	template <OptId Opt>
157	__global__ void __launch_bounds__(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK)
158	fused_mamba_megakernel(PersistentContext ctx,
159	                       float* __restrict__ params,
160	                       MambaTokenCtx tok,
161	                       float* __restrict__ grad,        // reduced grad [total]
162	                       float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
163	    extern __shared__ char mamba_smem_raw[];
164	    MambaSampleSmem& sm = *reinterpret_cast<MambaSampleSmem*>(mamba_smem_raw);
165	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
166	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
167	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
168	    const int64_t total = kMambaTotalElems;
169	    float* my_partial = tok.workspace + (int64_t)cta * total;   // this CTA's dW
170	    float* loss_part = tok.workspace + (int64_t)nCTA * total;   // [nCTA]
171	
172	    // NO warp-group register repartition here (UNLIKE the decoder/vit seams).
173	    // The decoder/vit copy a §3.4 producer/consumer setmaxnreg (dealloc<32> on
174	    // warpgroup 0, alloc<200> on warpgroup 1) — valid ONLY when warpgroup 0 needs
175	    // few registers. Mamba is NOT warp-specialized that way: ALL 256 threads do
176	    // SYMMETRIC selective-scan work, each thread owning a channel j∈[0,256) and
177	    // holding large register-resident scan state (fwd A[16]+h[16]; bwd adds
178	    // hh[kSeq+1][kState]+a_save[kSeq][kState]+dB_loc/dC_loc[kSeq][kState]+gh+dA),
179	    // so a dealloc<32> would spill it. __launch_bounds__(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK) sets the uniform
180	    // budget; the compiler allocates symmetrically across all 256 threads.
181	
182	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's grad-partial slice + its loss slot. ───────────────
183	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < total; i += blockDim.x) my_partial[i] = 0.0f;
184	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
185	    bar.sync();   // B0
186	
187	    // ── P1: batch-parallel fwd+bwd. Fixed contiguous slice [b0,b1) for this CTA.
188	    MambaWeights w = mb_bind(params);
189	    MambaGrad g = mb_bind_grad(my_partial);
190	    const int B = tok.B;
191	    const int base = B / nCTA, rem = B % nCTA;
192	    const int b0 = cta * base + (cta < rem ? cta : rem);
193	    const int cnt = base + (cta < rem ? 1 : 0);
194	    const int b1 = b0 + cnt;
195	    __shared__ int tok_s[mb::kSeq];   // this sample's token ids (broadcast)
196	    __shared__ int tgt_s;
197	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;              // fp32 slice accumulator (thread-0 holds it)
198	    for (int b = b0; b < b1; ++b) {
199	        if (threadIdx.x < mb::kSeq) tok_s[threadIdx.x] = tok.tokens[(int64_t)b * mb::kSeq + threadIdx.x];
200	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) tgt_s = tok.targets[b];
201	        __syncthreads();
202	        float nll = mb_forward_sample(w, tok_s, tgt_s, &sm);
203	        mb_backward_sample(w, g, tok_s, tgt_s, B, &sm);
204	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;   // fixed-order fp32 sum within slice
205	        __syncthreads();   // sample boundary: all grad writes done before reuse
206	    }
207	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
208	    bar.sync();   // B1: all CTA partials + loss slots complete
209	
210	    // ── P2: deterministic cross-CTA reduce. Work-steal the param ELEMENT-RANGES
211	    //    (one task = one parameter tensor; sum its elements across CTAs in
212	    //    ascending CTA index). Summation ORDER (ascending cta) is fixed →
213	    //    deterministic regardless of which CTA grabs the task. ─────────────────
214	    {
215	        __shared__ int task_slot;
216	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
217	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kMambaNumTensors;
218	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
219	            const int n = kMambaSizes[t];
220	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kMambaOffsets[t];
221	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x) {
222	                float acc = 0.0f;
223	                for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c)
224	                    acc += tok.workspace[(int64_t)c * total + off + i];
225	                grad[off + i] = acc;
226	            }
227	        }
228	    }
229	    // Loss reduction (fp64 ordered) by CTA 0 only — the loss rel-tol is the
230	    // tightest gate; fp32 atomic-summing many terms can miss it.
231	    if (cta == 0 && threadIdx.x == 0) {
232	        double s = 0.0;
233	        for (int c = 0; c < nCTA; ++c) s += (double)loss_part[c];
234	        float mean = (float)(s / (double)B);
235	        *tok.loss_out = mean;
236	    }
237	    bar.sync_reset(ctx.g_next_task);   // B2: reduced grad ready; reset queue for P3
238	
239	    // ── P3: the REAL optimizer tail over the reduced grad (work-steal the 28
240	    //    tensors). apply_optimizer<Opt> is the canonical csrc/algorithms math. ──
241	    st.lr = lr;
242	    {
243	        __shared__ int task_slot;
244	        TaskQueue q = ctx.queue();
245	        for (int t = q.next_block(&task_slot); t < kMambaNumTensors;
246	             t = q.next_block(&task_slot)) {
247	            const int n = kMambaSizes[t];
248	            const int64_t off = (int64_t)kMambaOffsets[t];
249	            const FusedOptState ts = mamba_rebase_state<Opt>(st, off);
250	            float* __restrict__ p = params + off;
251	            const float* __restrict__ gg = grad + off;
252	            for (int i = threadIdx.x; i < n; i += blockDim.x)
253	                apply_optimizer<Opt>(p, gg, (int64_t)i, step, ts);
254	        }
255	    }
256	}

258	// ── Host launcher — one persistent CTA per SM, 256 threads/CTA (2 warp-groups).
259	//    Mirrors launch_fused_decoder_megakernel's hang-freedom contract (occupancy≥1
260	//    or refuse), PLUS the DYNAMIC-SMEM opt-in that the Mamba footprint requires
261	//    (exactly as launch_fused_vit_megakernel does):
262	//      (1) cudaFuncSetAttribute(MaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, kMambaSmemBytes)
263	//      (2) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes in the occ≥1 query
264	//      (3) dynamicSMemBytes = kMambaSmemBytes at <<<...>>>
265	//    All three are mandatory; missing any one makes the launch silently fail. ───
266	template <OptId Opt>
267	cudaError_t launch_fused_mamba_megakernel(
268	        PersistentContext ctx, float* params, MambaTokenCtx tok,
269	        float* grad, float lr, int step, FusedOptState st, cudaStream_t stream) {
270	    int dev = 0;
271	    cudaError_t err = cudaGetDevice(&dev);
272	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
273	    int n_sms = 0;
274	    err = cudaDeviceGetAttribute(&n_sms, cudaDevAttrMultiProcessorCount, dev);
275	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
276	
277	    const int dyn_smem = (int)kMambaSmemBytes;   // 145124 B (≈141.72 KB)
278	
279	    // (1) Opt in to >48 KB dynamic smem for THIS kernel. Without this the launch
280	    //     fails with cudaErrorInvalidValue (the static 48 KB default applies).
281	    err = cudaFuncSetAttribute(
282	        (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>,
283	        cudaFuncAttributeMaxDynamicSharedMemorySize, dyn_smem);
284	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
285	
286	    // (2) Occupancy with the REAL dynamic-smem request (hang-freedom is honest).
287	    int occ = 0;
288	    err = cudaOccupancyMaxActiveBlocksPerMultiprocessor(
289	        &occ, (const void*)&fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt>, SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK,
290	        /*dynamicSMemBytes=*/dyn_smem);
291	    if (err != cudaSuccess) return err;
292	    // At least one CTA per SM must be resident or the grid barrier can never be
293	    // satisfied. ~141.72 KB dynamic smem fits the sm_90 ~227 KB cap at occ=1 (the
294	    // persistent megakernel is one-CTA-per-SM by design); if it cannot place one
295	    // block/SM, REFUSE rather than hang.
296	    assert(occ >= 1 &&
297	           "fused_mamba_megakernel: 0 blocks/SM — GridBarrier would hang. The "
298	           "Mamba per-sample smem (~142KB dynamic) + regs exceed one-block-per-SM "
299	           "occupancy on this device; reduce footprint or fall back to eager.");
300	    if (occ < 1) return cudaErrorLaunchOutOfResources;
301	
302	    const unsigned launch_ctas = (unsigned)n_sms;
303	    ctx.n_ctas = launch_ctas;
304	
305	    if (ctx.g_arrived) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_arrived, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
306	    if (ctx.g_generation) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_generation, 0, sizeof(unsigned), stream); if (err) return err; }
307	    if (ctx.g_next_task) { err = cudaMemsetAsync(ctx.g_next_task, 0, sizeof(int), stream); if (err) return err; }
308	
309	    // (3) Launch WITH the dynamic-smem byte count.
310	    dim3 grid(launch_ctas), block(SG_TUNED_MEGA_BLOCK);
311	    fused_mamba_megakernel<Opt><<<grid, block, dyn_smem, stream>>>(
312	        ctx, params, tok, grad, lr, step, st);
313	    return cudaGetLastError();
314	}

317	//  WGMMA CELL DRIVER (Fork B, R2 Mamba TC). Compiled only under the wgmma token;
318	//  the scalar path above is untouched. UNLIKE the scalar Mamba megakernel, this
319	//  uses STATIC smem (the per-(layer,sample) activation cache lives in HBM tile-
320	//  scratch, NOT smem — so NO dynamic-smem opt-in; the decoder TC launcher's
321	//  contract, not the scalar mamba launcher's three-step opt-in).
322	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
323	#if (SG_TUNED_GEMM_IMPL == SG_GEMM_IMPL_WGMMA)
324	
325	// TC megakernel threads: 256 (the scan owns channels 0..255; the wgmma is
326	// warpgroup-scoped on threads 0..127). No asymmetric setmaxnreg.
327	#define SG_MB_TC_MEGA_BLOCK 256
328	
329	// Min co-resident blocks/SM for __launch_bounds__. DEFAULT 1 = the shipped
330	// register-maximal (255 reg/thread → occ=1) one-CTA-per-SM config — which the
331	// PersistentContext GridBarrier (megakernel_common.cuh §1.4) is DESIGNED for
332	// ("occupancy=1 IS the design point", INTEGRATION-MAMBA §2). Setting 2 caps regs to
333	// ~128 so TWO CTAs co-reside per SM (occupancy-fill launches occ·n_sms CTAs below),
334	// which MEASURED 1.14× faster (B=16384 quiet, 113→99ms; the projection GEMMs are
335	// 0.1%-of-wall so the register trade is nearly free) BUT IS DETERMINISM-UNSAFE: the
336	// A/A/A gate proves occ=2 grads are NOT bit-identical across runs (max|Δ|=2.3e-10,
337	// timing-dependent), while occ=1 is exactly bit-identical — the hand-built grid
338	// barrier's two-fence visibility model assumes one CTA per SM, and co-residency
339	// exposes a P1-partial→P2-reduce visibility race. The barrier substrate fix lives in
340	// megakernel_common.cuh (NOT this lane); until it lands, occ=1 is mandatory (the
341	// no-suppression determinism gate is load-bearing). 0 → omit the bound (ptxas chooses).
342	#ifndef SG_MBTC_MIN_BLOCKS_PER_SM
343	#define SG_MBTC_MIN_BLOCKS_PER_SM 1
344	#endif
345	#if SG_MBTC_MIN_BLOCKS_PER_SM >= 1
346	#define SG_MBTC_LAUNCH_BOUNDS __launch_bounds__(SG_MB_TC_MEGA_BLOCK, SG_MBTC_MIN_BLOCKS_PER_SM)
347	#else
348	#define SG_MBTC_LAUNCH_BOUNDS __launch_bounds__(SG_MB_TC_MEGA_BLOCK)
349	#endif
350	
351	// ── PHASE PROFILER (default OFF; a separate measurement TU defines
352	//    SG_MB_TC_PROFILE to bracket P1-fwd/P1-bwd/P2/P3 with clock64() and write
353	//    per-CTA cumulative cycles to a profiling buffer carved from the workspace
354	//    tail). Production builds never define it → zero added code, zero ABI change.
355	#ifndef SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
356	#define SG_MB_TC_PROFILE 0
357	#endif
358	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
359	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS 8   // [p1fwd,p1bwd,p2,p3, p2-dwgemm,p2-reduce,p2-embed, witness]
360	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(v) do { __syncthreads(); if (threadIdx.x == 0) (v) = clock64(); } while (0)
361	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_ACC(slot, t0) do { __syncthreads(); \
362	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) prof[(int64_t)cta * SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS + (slot)] += (double)(clock64() - (t0)); } while (0)
363	#else
364	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(v) do {} while (0)
365	#define SG_MBTC_PROF_ACC(slot, t0) do {} while (0)
366	#endif
367	
368	// ── Static smem arena: kMbTcStages A(64×16) + kMbTcStages B(N×16) bf16 tiles
369	//    (the GEMM K-loop double-buffer ring — slot s at sA + s*64*16 / sB +
370	//    s*N*16) + the 256-float reduction slot + the scan-bwd cross-channel reduce
371	//    targets (dBmat/dCmat, [kSeq×kState] each) + the 8 dW specs (shared, not
372	//    per-thread stack). At S=2 + N=128 the ring is 2·(2KB+4KB)=12KB; MbTcSmem
373	//    total ~14.6KB ≪ the 48KB static cap (the TC launcher uses static smem). ──
374	struct MbTcSmem {
375	    __nv_bfloat16 sA[mbtc::kMbTcStages * 64 * 16];
376	    __nv_bfloat16 sB[mbtc::kMbTcStages * SG_TUNED_TILE_N * 16];
377	    float red[256];
378	    float dBmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
379	    float dCmat[mb::kSeq * mb::kState];
380	    mbtc::MbDwSpec spec[8];
381	};
382	
383	// TC workspace layout (carved from tok.workspace; host sizes it):
384	//   [0 .. acts_f)                          : MbActs bf16 region
385	//   [acts_f .. + nCTA*scratch)             : per-CTA tile scratch (f32)
386	//   [.. + nCTA*kPartElems)                 : per-CTA non-GEMM grad partials (f32)
387	//   [.. + nCTA)                            : per-CTA loss slots
388	//   [.. + 1)                               : reduced scalar loss
389	//   [.. + mb_dw_part_floats(G))            : split-K dW partials (G>1 only; the
390	//                                            (gt,kc) 64×N partial tiles P2 reduces)
391	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_acts_floats(int T) {
392	    return mbtc::mb_acts_floats(T);
393	}
394	// dW split-K partial floats (0 when G==1 → no extra scratch, the single-CTA path).
395	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_dw_part_floats() {
396	    return (mbtc::kMbDwSplitK > 1) ? mbtc::mb_dw_part_floats(mbtc::kMbDwSplitK) : 0;
397	}
398	// STAGED-optimizer cross-CTA reduction scratch (Prodigy d-estimate). Mirrors the
399	// decoder's dec_tc_opt_reduce_floats: the Prodigy P2.6 stage publishes per-CTA (r,s)
400	// slots (2*nCTA) + a reduced-d broadcast slot (1) — an owner-computes tree
401	// (opt_stages_precompute.cuh), NO float atomic. Sized for the LARGEST nCTA (one
402	// CTA/SM = #SMs); tiny (≤ 2*132+1 ≈ 1 KB) and carved UNCONDITIONALLY so the opt-
403	// agnostic cached launcher workspace fits every OptId. Unused by AdamW/Lion/… (their
404	// P3 never touches this region), so adding it leaves those cells byte-identical.
405	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(int nCTA) {
406	    return (int64_t)2 * nCTA + 1;            // [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
407	}
408	// ── LookSAM (STAGED in-kernel SAM 2nd backward) transient scratch — the Mamba twin of
409	//    the decoder's dec_tc_looksam_floats. The SAM step perturbs p in place, runs a
410	//    SECOND fwd+bwd at p', and needs (a) a param BACKUP for the exact restore (eager
411	//    clones p before perturbing; an fp32 add is not bit-reversible, so save — don't
412	//    subtract back) + (b) a SEPARATE g_sam grad buffer so the 2nd backward does NOT
413	//    clobber the first grad `grad` (sam_dir = g_sam − grad reads both). Both are total-
414	//    sized + transient (NOT persistent state — sam_dir itself persists in the `extra`
415	//    state slice, bound by the cell). Carved UNCONDITIONALLY (≈ 2·kMambaTotalElems)
416	//    so the opt-agnostic launcher fits every OptId; unused by every non-LookSAM cell
417	//    (its P2.4 phase is if-constexpr'd out → byte-identical). The ‖g‖ reduction reuses
418	//    the loss workspace (sq_part/ron_bc, as GrokAdamW's P2.5 / the decoder twin do), so
419	//    no extra here. ──
420	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_looksam_floats() {
421	    return (int64_t)2 * kMambaTotalElems;    // [sam_backup | sam_grad]
422	}
423	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_tc_workspace_floats(int T, int nCTA) {
424	    return mb_tc_acts_floats(T)
425	         + (int64_t)nCTA * mbtc::mb_tile_scratch_floats()
426	         + (int64_t)nCTA * mbtc::kPartElems
427	         + nCTA + 1
428	         + mb_tc_dw_part_floats()                       // split-K dW partials (G>1)
429	         + mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA)                // STAGED-opt (Prodigy) reduce slots
430	         + mb_tc_looksam_floats()                       // STAGED-opt (LookSAM) SAM 2nd-bwd scratch
431	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
432	         + (int64_t)nCTA * SG_MBTC_PROF_SLOTS * 2 + 2  // phase-profiler (doubles=2 floats) + align pad
433	#endif
434	         ;
435	}

437	template <OptId Opt>
438	__global__ void SG_MBTC_LAUNCH_BOUNDS
439	fused_mamba_megakernel_tc(PersistentContext ctx,
440	                          float* __restrict__ params,
441	                          MambaTokenCtx tok,
442	                          float* __restrict__ grad,
443	                          float lr, int step, FusedOptState st) {
444	    __shared__ MbTcSmem sm;
445	    GridBarrier bar = ctx.barrier();
446	    const int cta = blockIdx.x;
447	    const int nCTA = (int)ctx.n_ctas;
448	    const int B = tok.B;
449	    const int T = B * mb::kSeq;
450	
451	    // Workspace partition.
452	    float* ws = tok.workspace;
453	    const int64_t acts_f = mb_tc_acts_floats(T);
454	    __nv_bfloat16* acts_base = reinterpret_cast<__nv_bfloat16*>(ws);
455	    float* scratch_base = ws + acts_f;
456	    const int64_t scratch_per = mbtc::mb_tile_scratch_floats();
457	    float* part_base = scratch_base + (int64_t)nCTA * scratch_per;
458	    float* loss_part = part_base + (int64_t)nCTA * mbtc::kPartElems;
459	    float* loss_out  = loss_part + nCTA;
460	    // Split-K dW partials (G>1): the (gt,kc) 64×N partial tiles, carved AFTER the
461	    // loss slot (matches mb_tc_workspace_floats's term order). G==1 → dw_part unused.
462	    float* dw_part   = loss_out + 1;
463	    const int kDwG   = mbtc::kMbDwSplitK;
464	    // STAGED-opt (Prodigy P2.6) cross-CTA reduce slots: [r slots | s slots | reduced d]
465	    // = 2*nCTA+1, carved AFTER the split-K dW partials (matches mb_tc_workspace_floats's
466	    // term order). Unused by every non-Prodigy tail (their P3 never touches it), so this
467	    // pointer derivation leaves those cells byte-identical.
468	    float* opt_reduce = dw_part + mb_tc_dw_part_floats();
469	    // LookSAM SAM 2nd-backward scratch, carved AFTER the Prodigy reduce slots (mamba has
470	    // NO Muon region — unlike the decoder/vit twins — so this follows opt_reduce; term
471	    // order matches mb_tc_workspace_floats). Carving it here keeps every prior region's
472	    // offset unchanged, so the already-green cells are byte-identical. Layout:
473	    //   [sam_backup (total)] [sam_grad (total)]. Unused unless Opt==LookSAM.
474	    float* sam_backup = opt_reduce + mb_tc_opt_reduce_floats(nCTA);
475	    float* sam_grad   = sam_backup + kMambaTotalElems;
476	#if SG_MB_TC_PROFILE
477	    // 8-byte align the double accumulator: round the float offset up to an even
478	    // count so reinterpret_cast<double*> is aligned (past the LookSAM sam scratch — the
479	    // phase-profiler is the LAST workspace term, mirroring mb_tc_workspace_floats).
480	    float* prof_f = sam_grad + kMambaTotalElems;
481	    uintptr_t _pa = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(prof_f);
482	    if (_pa & 0x7u) prof_f = reinterpret_cast<float*>((_pa + 7u) & ~uintptr_t(7u));
483	    double* prof = reinterpret_cast<double*>(prof_f);   // [nCTA*SLOTS], host-zeroed
484	    long long _pt = 0;
485	#endif
486	
487	    mbtc::MbActs acts = mbtc::mb_acts_bind(acts_base, T);
488	    mbtc::MbTileScratch sc = mbtc::mb_tile_scratch_bind(scratch_base + (int64_t)cta * scratch_per);
489	    float* my_part = part_base + (int64_t)cta * mbtc::kPartElems;
490	    mbtc::MbPartial part = mbtc::mb_partial_bind(my_part);
491	
492	    MambaWeights w = mb_bind(params);
493	
494	    // ── P0: zero this CTA's non-GEMM grad partial + loss slot. ──
495	    for (int64_t i = threadIdx.x; i < mbtc::kPartElems; i += blockDim.x) my_part[i] = 0.0f;
496	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = 0.0f;
497	    bar.sync();   // B0
498	
499	    // ── P1: sample-tile-parallel fwd+bwd. Each CTA grid-strides over tiles of
500	    //    kTileM rows; fwd (→ acts X, NLL) then bwd (→ acts dY, dh0, partial). ──
501	    const int nrows_tile = mbtc::kTileM;
502	    const int n_tiles = (T + nrows_tile - 1) / nrows_tile;
503	    float nll_acc = 0.0f;
504	    for (int ti = cta; ti < n_tiles; ti += nCTA) {
505	        const int g0 = ti * nrows_tile;
506	        const int nrows = (T - g0) < nrows_tile ? (T - g0) : nrows_tile;
507	        SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(_pt);
508	        float nll = mbtc::mbtc_forward_tile(w, g0, nrows, acts, sc, tok.tokens, tok.targets,
509	                                            sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red);
510	        SG_MBTC_PROF_ACC(0, _pt);
511	        SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(_pt);
512	        mbtc::mbtc_backward_tile(w, g0, nrows, B, acts, sc, part, tok.tokens, tok.targets,
513	                                 sm.sA, sm.sB, sm.red, sm.dBmat, sm.dCmat);
514	        SG_MBTC_PROF_ACC(1, _pt);
515	        if (threadIdx.x == 0) nll_acc += nll;
516	        __syncthreads();
517	    }
518	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) loss_part[cta] = nll_acc;
519	    bar.sync();   // B1: all acts (X + dY + dh0) + partials complete
520	    SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(_pt);
521	
522	    // ── P2: assemble all 28 grads. 8 projection dW output-stationary (gt %
523	    //    nCTA), dt_proj.bias, non-GEMM partial-reduce, embedding owner-scan. ──
524	    if (threadIdx.x == 0) mbtc::mbtc_build_dw_specs(acts, T, sm.spec);
525	    __syncthreads();
526	    mbtc::MbDwSpec* spec = sm.spec;
527	    const int n_dw = mbtc::mbtc_dw_total_tiles<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec);
528	    SG_MBTC_PROF_TIC(_pt);
529	#if !SG_MBTC_BYPASS_DW_GEMM
530	    if (kDwG > 1) {
531	        // SPLIT-K (multi-CTA tiling): fan (n_dw·G) (tile,chunk) partials over the
532	        // grid so the ~73% idle SMs do work; deterministic ascending-chunk reduce.
533	        for (int item = cta; item < n_dw * kDwG; item += nCTA) {
534	            const int gt = item / kDwG, kc = item % kDwG;
535	            mbtc::mbtc_dw_run_tile_splitk<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec, gt, kc, kDwG, dw_part, sm.sA, sm.sB);
536	        }
537	        bar.sync();   // all (gt,kc) partials complete before the reduce reads them
538	        mbtc::mbtc_dw_reduce_splitk<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec, n_dw, kDwG, dw_part, grad, cta, nCTA);
539	    } else {
540	        for (int gt = cta; gt < n_dw; gt += nCTA)
541	            mbtc::mbtc_dw_run_tile<SG_TUNED_TILE_N>(spec, gt, grad, sm.sA, sm.sB);
542	    }

The race lives in the shared mamba TC forward/backward/scan. The key insight: mamba×{adamw,lion,grokfast,grokadamw,neuralgrok} are A/A/A bit-identical, so the race only manifests with the OTHER opts (prodigy/muon/looksam/sg11/sg15) which have different occupancy/layout.

Let me read the TC kernel files which are where the actual shared race must be — `model_stage_mamba_tc.cuh`, `mamba3_layout.cuh`, and the TC forward/backward tile functions. Let me also look at the prodigy P2.6 fix (0cd8f75) for the deterministic pattern to mirror.

125	template <int MN, typename Src>
126	__device__ __forceinline__ void stage_kmajor_tile(
127	        __nv_bfloat16* smem_tile, int kbase, Src src, int t0, int nthreads) {
128	    #pragma unroll 1
129	    for (int i = t0; i < MN * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK; i += nthreads) {

132	        const int dst = (k >> 3) * (MN * 8) + mn * 8 + (k & 7);
133	        smem_tile[dst] = src(mn, kbase + k);

170	//  SOFTWARE-PIPELINED single-CTA batch GEMM: D[M,N] = Σ_k A[m,k]·B[n,k], bf16
171	//  operands (accessor-sourced + Major-K staged), fp32 accumulator, ASCENDING-k.
172	//  One warpgroup (threads 0..127) issues the wgmma; all `nthreads` stage. The
173	//  staging of tile k+1 OVERLAPS the async wgmma on tile k (a kMbTcStages-deep
174	//  smem ring buffer hides the HBM-acts latency the dW K-loop (K=T=B·kSeq) is
175	//  bound by — every k-step pulls fresh operands from HBM). NUMERICS are
176	//  byte-identical to the old serial form: the accumulator is the SAME fp32
177	//  WgmmaAccum, issued in the SAME ascending-k order with ScaleD=0 on k=0 then

179	//  So the 0.08 per-tensor parity AND A/A/A bit-determinism hold by construction.
180	//  (Kept the name `tc_gemm_block_unpipelined` so the dozens of call sites + the

182	//  MaxAtomsM bounds the register accumulator (compile-time). n_real<=N
183	//  suppresses ragged pad columns. smemA/smemB are the RING BASES (kMbTcStages

186	template <int N, int MaxAtomsM, typename SrcA, typename SrcB, typename Out>
187	__device__ void tc_gemm_block_unpipelined(
188	        int mbase0, int m_atoms, int n_real, int k_steps,
189	        SrcA srcA, SrcB srcB, Out out,
190	        __nv_bfloat16* smemA, __nv_bfloat16* smemB) {

193	    const int nthreads = blockDim.x;
194	    const bool in_wg0 = (tid < 128);
195	    const int tid_wg = tid & 127;
196	    constexpr int S = kMbTcStages;
197	
198	    wgs::WgmmaAccum<N> acc[MaxAtomsM];
199	
200	    // Stage tile `k` of atom `mbase` into ring slot `k % S`.
201	    auto stage_k = [&] (int mbase, int k) {
202	        const int s = k % S;
203	        stage_kmajor_tile<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM>(
204	            smemA + (int64_t)s * kMbTcSmemA1, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
205	            [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcA(mbase + mn, kk); }, tid, nthreads);
206	        stage_kmajor_tile<N>(
207	            smemB + (int64_t)s * kMbTcSmemB1, k * wgs::kWgmmaAtomK,
208	            [&] (int mn, int kk) { return srcB(mn, kk); }, tid, nthreads);
209	    };
210	    // Issue the wgmma reading ring slot `k % S` into acc[a] (ScaleD per k).
211	    auto issue_k = [&] (int a, int k) {
212	        const int s = k % S;
213	        wgs::SmemDesc dA = wgs::make_desc_A_kmajor<wgs::kWgmmaAtomM, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(
214	            smemA + (int64_t)s * kMbTcSmemA1);
215	        wgs::SmemDesc dB = wgs::make_desc_B_kmajor<N, wgs::kSwizzleNone>(
216	            smemB + (int64_t)s * kMbTcSmemB1);
217	        if (k == 0) wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/0, 0, 0>(acc[a], dA, dB);
218	        else        wgs::wgmma_m64nNk16_bf16<N, /*ScaleD=*/1, 0, 0>(acc[a], dA, dB);
219	    };

221	    #pragma unroll 1
222	    for (int a = 0; a < m_atoms; ++a) {
223	        const int mbase = mbase0 + a * wgs::kWgmmaAtomM;
224	        // ── Prologue: stage tile 0 into slot 0; make it visible; fence. ──
225	        stage_k(mbase, 0);
226	        __syncthreads();                 // tile 0 visible to the wgmma below
227	        if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_fence();
228	        // ── Steady state (S=2 single-in-flight double-buffer): issue wgmma(k)
229	        //    on the already-staged slot k&1 (async), THEN stage tile k+1 into the
230	        //    OTHER slot (k+1)&1 — its HBM operand loads run CONCURRENTLY with the
231	        //    async MMA — THEN wait_group<0> (wgmma(k) done reading slot k&1) and
232	        //    __syncthreads (stage(k+1) visible AND slot k&1 reuse-safe for k+2).
233	        //    Invariant: stage(k+1)'s slot was last read by wgmma(k-1), retired by
234	        //    iter k-1's wait+sync; the per-iter wait_group<0> is load-bearing (it
235	        //    is what makes a slot reusable). S=1 collapses to the serial path
236	        //    (issue → stage(none for k+1 since stages share a slot)… handled
237	        //    below): for S==1 we stage k+1 into the SAME slot AFTER the wait, so
238	        //    it is bit-identical to the old per-k stage→sync→issue→wait. ─────────
239	        #pragma unroll 1
240	        for (int k = 0; k < k_steps; ++k) {
241	            if (in_wg0) {
242	                issue_k(a, k);
243	                wgs::wgmma_commit_group();
244	            }
245	            if (S > 1) {
246	                // Double-buffer: prefetch k+1 into the other slot, overlapping wgmma(k).
247	                if (k + 1 < k_steps) stage_k(mbase, k + 1);
248	                if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_wait_group<0>();   // wgmma(k) done reading slot k&1
249	                __syncthreads();                          // stage(k+1) visible; slot k&1 free
250	            } else {
251	                // Serial (S==1, single slot): wait, then stage next into the slot.
252	                if (in_wg0) wgs::wgmma_wait_group<0>();
253	                __syncthreads();                          // wgmma(k) done reading the slot
254	                if (k + 1 < k_steps) { stage_k(mbase, k + 1); __syncthreads(); }
255	            }
256	        }

259	            for (int i = 0; i < wgs::WgmmaAccum<N>::kRegs; ++i) {
260	                int row, col;
261	                wgs::wgmma_frag_decode(tid_wg, i, N, row, col);

268	    (void)mbase0; (void)m_atoms; (void)n_real; (void)k_steps;

273	// k_steps with PADDING: K is padded UP to a multiple of 16; the staging
274	// accessor must return 0 for k >= K_real (the pad rows). dt_proj contracts K=8,
275	// x_proj-dX contracts K=dbc=40 — NEITHER a multiple of 16. ceil, not floor.
276	__device__ __host__ __forceinline__ int kceil16(int K) {
277	    return (K + wgs::kWgmmaAtomK - 1) / wgs::kWgmmaAtomK;
278	}
279	
280	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
281	//  THIN ORIENTATION WRAPPERS (mbtc_gemm_*). Three accessor patterns: fwd
282	//  (Y=X·Wᵀ), dX (dX=dY·W, W transposed-staged), dW (dW=dYᵀ·X, both transposed,
283	//  K=T). M = kTileM (kAtomsM stacked atoms). Weights convert fp32→bf16 ON READ
284	//  (deterministic; no bf16 weight buffer). PAD-AWARE: srcA/srcB return 0 for
285	//  k >= K_real so a K not divisible by 16 (dt_proj K=8, x_proj-dX K=40) is
286	//  zero-extended; n_real marks the valid output columns for a ragged N tile.
287	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
288	
289	// (fwd) Y[M,Nout] = X[M,Kin] @ W[Nout,Kin]ᵀ.  Tiles N over [0,Nout) in width-N
290	// atoms. Kin may be non-/16 (dt_proj Kin=dt_rank=8 → padded). Writes bf16
291	// Y [M,Nout] at `Yout` (the projection output, stored bf16).
292	template <int N>
293	__device__ __forceinline__ void mbtc_gemm_fwd_bf16(
294	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ X, const float* __restrict__ W,
295	        __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ Yout, int Kin, int Nout,
296	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
297	    const int k_steps = kceil16(Kin);
298	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Nout; n0 += N) {
299	        const int n_real = (Nout - n0) < N ? (Nout - n0) : N;
300	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
301	            return k < Kin ? X[(int64_t)m * Kin + k] : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
302	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
303	            int nn = n0 + n; return (nn < Nout && k < Kin) ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)nn * Kin + k]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
304	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) {
305	            Yout[(int64_t)m * Nout + n0 + n] = __float2bfloat16(v); };
306	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
307	            0, kAtomsM, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
308	    }
309	}

311	// Same as fwd but emits fp32 (no bf16 round) into `Yf32` — for projection
312	// outputs consumed by fp32 elementwise stages (dt_pre, the scan inputs).
313	template <int N>
314	__device__ __forceinline__ void mbtc_gemm_fwd_f32(
315	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ X, const float* __restrict__ W,
316	        float* __restrict__ Yf32, int Kin, int Nout,
317	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
318	    const int k_steps = kceil16(Kin);
319	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Nout; n0 += N) {
320	        const int n_real = (Nout - n0) < N ? (Nout - n0) : N;
321	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
322	            return k < Kin ? X[(int64_t)m * Kin + k] : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
323	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
324	            int nn = n0 + n; return (nn < Nout && k < Kin) ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)nn * Kin + k]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
325	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) { Yf32[(int64_t)m * Nout + n0 + n] = v; };
326	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
327	            0, kAtomsM, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
328	    }
329	}

331	// (dX) dX[M,Kin] = dY[M,Nout] @ W[Nout,Kin].  N(wgmma)=Kin (tiled by N). K=Nout
332	// (the contracted out_dim) — may be non-/16 (x_proj dX K=dbc=40 → padded).
333	// W staged transposed: srcB(n=kin, k=out)=W[out·Kin+kin]. Writes fp32 dX [M,Kin].
334	template <int N>
335	__device__ __forceinline__ void mbtc_gemm_dx_f32(
336	        const __nv_bfloat16* __restrict__ dY, const float* __restrict__ W,
337	        float* __restrict__ dXf32, int Kin, int Nout,
338	        __nv_bfloat16* sA, __nv_bfloat16* sB) {
339	    const int k_steps = kceil16(Nout);
340	    for (int n0 = 0; n0 < Kin; n0 += N) {
341	        const int n_real = (Kin - n0) < N ? (Kin - n0) : N;
342	        auto srcA = [&] (int m, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
343	            return k < Nout ? dY[(int64_t)m * Nout + k] : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
344	        auto srcB = [&] (int n, int k) -> __nv_bfloat16 {
345	            int nn = n0 + n; return (nn < Kin && k < Nout) ? __float2bfloat16(W[(int64_t)k * Kin + nn]) : __float2bfloat16(0.f); };
346	        auto out  = [&] (int m, int n, float v) { dXf32[(int64_t)m * Kin + n0 + n] = v; };
347	        tc_gemm_block_unpipelined<N, /*MaxAtomsM=*/kAtomsM>(
348	            0, kAtomsM, n_real, k_steps, srcA, srcB, out, sA, sB);
349	    }
350	}

352	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
353	//  HBM bf16 ACTS buffer (Fork B). The projection-dW operands (X-inputs and
354	//  dY-adjoints) the cross-tile P2 dW owners read. Token-row-major [T, width]
355	//  (= sample-major [nsamp][kSeq][width] since rows are sample-ordered). Carved
356	//  from the FRONT of the workspace; offsets are RUNTIME (depend on T=B·kSeq).
357	//
358	//  The 4 projections' dW = dYᵀ@X needs, per layer:
359	//    in_proj  dW[512,128] = dxz^T  @ layer_in : X_in    [T,128], dY_dxz   [T,512]
360	//    x_proj   dW[40,256]  = dxdbc^T@ x_main   : X_xmain  [T,256], dY_dxdbc [T,40]
361	//    dt_proj  dW[256,8]   = ddtpre^T@ dt_raw  : X_dtraw  [T,8],   dY_ddtpre[T,256]
362	//    out_proj dW[128,256] = dyout^T @ y_gated : X_ygated [T,256], dY_dyout [T,128]
363	//  (dt_proj.bias = Σ_T ddt_pre — free P2 bias pass. in/x/out_proj have no bias.)
364	//  The HEAD (out.w/out.b) stays scalar → no acts. dh0 [T,128] feeds tok/pos owner-scan.
365	// ════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
366	// (still in namespace mbtc — opened above)
367	
368	struct MbActs {
369	    __nv_bfloat16* X_in[mb::kLayers];      // [T, d]        in_proj input (layer input, bf16)
370	    __nv_bfloat16* X_xmain[mb::kLayers];   // [T, d_inner]  x_proj input (bf16 copy of x_main)
371	    __nv_bfloat16* X_dtraw[mb::kLayers];   // [T, dt_rank]  dt_proj input (bf16 dt_raw)
372	    __nv_bfloat16* X_ygated[mb::kLayers];  // [T, d_inner]  out_proj input (bf16 y_gated)
373	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_dxz[mb::kLayers];    // [T, 2*d_inner] in_proj output adjoint (bf16 dxz)
374	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_dxdbc[mb::kLayers];  // [T, dbc]      x_proj output adjoint (bf16 dx_dbc)
375	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_ddtpre[mb::kLayers]; // [T, d_inner]  dt_proj output adjoint (bf16 ddt_pre)
376	    __nv_bfloat16* dY_dyout[mb::kLayers];  // [T, d]        out_proj output adjoint (bf16 dy_out)
377	    __nv_bfloat16* dh0;                    // [T, d]        embedding-input adjoint
378	};
379	
380	// Running bf16-element offset for the acts region (host + device must agree).
381	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_acts_bf16_count(int T) {
382	    const int64_t d = mb::kD, di = mb::kDInner, dr = mb::kDtRank, dbc = mb::kDbc;
383	    const int64_t Td = (int64_t)T * d, Tdi = (int64_t)T * di, Tdr = (int64_t)T * dr,
384	                  Tdbc = (int64_t)T * dbc, T2di = (int64_t)T * 2 * di;
385	    int64_t bf = 0;
386	    for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li)
387	        bf += Td + Tdi + Tdr + Tdi + T2di + Tdbc + Tdi + Td;   // X_in,X_xmain,X_dtraw,X_ygated,dY_dxz,dY_dxdbc,dY_ddtpre,dY_dyout
388	    bf += Td;                                                  // dh0
389	    return bf;
390	}
391	__host__ __device__ __forceinline__ int64_t mb_acts_floats(int T) {
392	    return (mb_acts_bf16_count(T) + 1) / 2;
393	}
394	
395	__device__ __forceinline__ MbActs mb_acts_bind(__nv_bfloat16* p, int T) {
396	    MbActs a;
397	    int64_t off = 0;
398	    const int64_t Td = (int64_t)T * mb::kD, Tdi = (int64_t)T * mb::kDInner,
399	                  Tdr = (int64_t)T * mb::kDtRank, Tdbc = (int64_t)T * mb::kDbc,
400	                  T2di = (int64_t)T * 2 * mb::kDInner;
401	    for (int li = 0; li < mb::kLayers; ++li) {
402	        a.X_in[li]      = p + off; off += Td;
403	        a.X_xmain[li]   = p + off; off += Tdi;
404	        a.X_dtraw[li]   = p + off; off += Tdr;
405	        a.X_ygated[li]  = p + off; off += Tdi;
406	        a.dY_dxz[li]    = p + off; off += T2di;
407	        a.dY_dxdbc[li]  = p + off; off += Tdbc;
408	        a.dY_ddtpre[li] = p + off; off += Tdi;
409	        a.dY_dyout[li]  = p + off; off += Td;
410	    }
411	    a.dh0 = p + off; off += Td;
412	    return a;
413	}
